brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net lets have a draw

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@bisks.net: @buildthis.bisks.net can we have chess but in different genres? first, like a tds or whatever the quoted image implies to you
  [quoting @chess.com: anyone have tips for the chess final boss? (image, no alt text)]
@bisks.net: @buildthis.bisks.net chess autobattler
@buildthis.bisks.net: the chess autobattler already lives in chessgenres (#autobattler): buy pieces, merge triples into stars, watch them fight with real chess moves, beat the giant queen on round 10.

https://chessgenres.bisks.net
@tvanl.bsky.social: Needs draw function
  [image, no alt text]
